title: Show MEZ rings for all forces
body:
Generate attributes for all forces (which then allows Planning-Forcesto render MEZ ranges for all assets)

Fixes #2619

issues.title: All forces see all Mez circles
issues.body:
Players can switch on MEZ ranges.

They currently only see MEZ for own-forces.

We wish to make a change so that MEZ range is also seen for friendly and Opp-forces.

For Opp-forces, the MEZ range will be on the marker for the last known location of he opp-force asset (perfect for blue/green perception of red, potentially time-late for red perception of blue-green).
